lines.text: What if all the *plastic* on Earth disappeared... for five seconds?
It's everywhere. Phones, cars, signs... and probably the clothes you're wearing right now.
More than half of all fabric made today is *polyester*. And polyester is plastic.
So about half of Times Square just lost its *jacket*.
And every car? Half its volume is plastic, but less than a tenth of its weight.
Five seconds later, it all comes back.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
